Herds.ExpeditionEventDef.label: Rising Storm
Herds.ExpeditionEventDef.narrative: Dark weather closes over the route. The party can retreat, push through exposed ground, or shelter and lose time.

li.label: Turn Back
li.description: Abandon the objective and return safely.
li.result: The party turned back before the storm closed the route.

li.label: Press On
li.description: Keep moving, accepting greater danger for a better chance to reach the target.
li.result: The party pressed through the storm.

li.label: Make Shelter
li.description: Wait out the worst weather. The delay reduces immediate danger.
li.result: The party built shelter and waited for safer conditions.

Herds.ExpeditionEventDef.label: Fresh Wildlife Crossing
Herds.ExpeditionEventDef.narrative: Fresh tracks cross the party's route. Following them may improve the expedition's position, but the detour is uncertain.

li.label: Turn Back
li.description: End the expedition rather than risk the uncertain crossing.
li.result: The party abandoned the expedition at the crossing.

li.label: Press On
li.description: Ignore the crossing and maintain the planned route.
li.result: The party kept to its original route.

li.label: Read the Tracks
li.description: Spend time studying the crossing for knowledge and improved contact chances.
li.result: The party read the crossing and adjusted its search.

Herds.ExpeditionEventDef.label: Predator Sign
Herds.ExpeditionEventDef.narrative: A large predator has recently worked the same ground. The party must decide whether to withdraw, press on, or circle downwind.

li.label: Turn Back
li.description: Leave the contested ground and return home.
li.result: The party withdrew from the predator's range.

li.label: Press On
li.description: Continue directly, improving contact at substantial risk.
li.result: The party pressed into the predator's range.

li.label: Circle Downwind
li.description: Take a slower route that lowers danger but sacrifices some opportunity.
li.result: The party circled downwind and avoided the freshest sign.
